system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The reward function prompt template we designed (see Figure 2) starts with a guided system prompt
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only. The bundled repository is jedi, not RepoUnderstander. Figures 2 and 3 show templates with {issue} and {collected_content} variables.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we follow AutoCodeRover[53]'s information retrieval method and use API search tools to extract information in the repository knowledge graph.
env_context_strategy.note: MCTS/BM25-selected repository experience is injected up front, and the agent then navigates with search_class, search_method and search_code.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we only use the location description of the relevant code fragments (i.e., structural dependencies in the repository) and the output of the Summary Agent (i.e., summary and planning) as Ling-
context_compaction.note: A summary agent condenses the collected snippets. There is no history processor evidence because the repo is missing.

observation_format.evidence_quote: search for classes, methods and code snippets in the repository knowledge graph, and finally return the results to the agent.

tool_call_format.note: No parser code is available; the bundled repo is jedi.

tool_count.note: The paper names three search APIs followed by '...'. There is no tool registry.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: a diff is generated based on the code snippet before modifi-cation and the code snippet after modification
edit_primitive.note: Closest value: the model emits a modified snippet and the harness diffs it against the original.

protocol_standardization.note: No source or dependency files for the harness are available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: LingmaAgent involves three key steps, repository knowledge graph construction stage, MCTS-enhanced repository understanding stage, information utilization & patch generation stage.
loop_primitives.note: Sec. 3.4 describes ReAct for dynamic information acquisition, and Sec. 3.3 describes MCTS.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: outputs a summary of the relevant fragments in sequence and plans a solution.
planning_granularity.note: The plan is free-text summary agent output; no plan object is described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: To more effectively utilize the global repository information collected during the repository understand-ing phase, we introduce a summary agent.
multi_agent_topology.note: The reward agent, summary agent and main agent run in a fixed sequence.

human_in_loop.note: Human-in-the-loop appears only as an in-house evaluation protocol (Sec. 4.5), not as a shipped mechanism.

self_verification.evidence_quote: If a diff is incorrect due to syntax, we will retry until an applicable patch with correct syntax is generated.
self_verification.note: The default is a syntax/apply check. The review agent (llm_judge) and execution feedback exist only as ablation or variant configurations (Sec. 4.2, 4.4).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: set the maximum number of retries to 3 to ensure that the generated patch can be applied as much as possible.
retry_policy.note: These are patch-generation retries on unapplicable diffs.

termination_condition.note: The MCTS stage is capped at 600 iterations, but whole-run termination is not described.

timeouts.evidence_quote: we set the number of search iterations to 600 and maximum search time to 300 seconds.
timeouts.note: This is a time limit on the MCTS stage only.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: we use the well-build open source docker of the AutoCodeRover [53] team for experiments.

eval_hooks.note: The harness repo is not in the bundle.

target_domain.evidence_quote: LingmaAgent can automatically solve real-world issues.

open_source.note: The paper says a Python prototype is open-sourced, but no LICENSE for RepoUnderstander is in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we experimented with different models and found that performance improved significantly with more advanced mod-els.
model_agnostic.note: GPT-4, GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 were used. No client abstraction is visible.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: we have open-sourced a Python prototype of LingmaAgent for reference by other industrial developers
primary_artifact.note: The repository evidence bundle is davidhalter/jedi (a dependency), not the harness repo.

first_release_date.note: Neither a tag nor a paper v1 date is in the evidence; the arXiv id is 2406.01422 (v2 dated 26 Mar 2025).

pinned_version.note: The pinned ref in the bundle is jedi v0.20.0, the wrong repository.

stars.note: The 6178 stars shown belong to jedi, not RepoUnderstander.
